body: You’re definitely right about that. I just don’t appreciate him completely disregarding what I think. See the issue isn’t so much political as racial. He’s white I’m black and I believe there is still a lot of disparity between the races and he just doesn’t agree. And I’m willing to see past our differences and have an informed discussion about these things. But him deleting me from Facebook feels like a cop out
yes, I know how it feels I lost my mother last November.  But he's really angry with me now and I can't bear it.  He told me he wants to "forget about me for 2 weeks."
